column3: “Lord” is repeated to specify theirs and ours.
The passive giving of grace is recast actively with God as subject.
Speaking the same thing is rendered as agreeing together.
“I follow” renders the statements of belonging.
“Wisdom” and “strength” are supplied in the comparisons with humans.
BSB’s “in His presence” matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “before God” (θεοῦ).
